name: Summer Vacation
source:
Me and my friends (all girls) watched fireworks together each year.
This year I thought we'd do the same, but everyone's taking a boy.
I didn't want to be left alone... I need a date!

Can you overcome your shyness and get a date to the fireworks festival?

[from DLsite]
